title: Enter rider details
caption: Enter the patient name and contact information.

title: Add the route
caption: Enter the pickup address and destination.

title: Choose ride and schedule
caption: Select the ride type, date, and appointment time.

title: Enter your coupon
caption: Before Book My Ride, enter the coupon exactly as provided.

title: Apply and verify
caption: Select Apply and confirm the discounted total appears.

title: Continue booking
caption: Select Book My Ride only after the coupon is applied.

title: Review the final fare
caption: Review and confirm the discounted fare.

title: Complete payment
caption: Pay the deposit or the discounted total in full.
